name: medium-core-off-reboot-primary
title: MLAG primary reboot · Medium lab, STP off on the MLAG pair, RSTP on the access switch (campus option 1)
action: Resets the data bridge on all three CHRs over management SSH: protocol-mode=none and forward-reserved-addresses=no on both MLAG peers, protocol-mode=rstp priority=0x0000 on the access switch, with edge=yes on its uplink bond and edge=yes, bpdu-guard=yes and loop-protect=on on its host port ether4, and reads the access switch port settings back. It requires a loss-free probe baseline, no BPDU from or through the MLAG pair and one copy of each broadcast. It then reboots CHR 1 (MLAG primary, mlag-priority=10) with `/system reboot`, waits for the guest uptime to reset and keeps probing for 16 s plus a 3 s recovery window.

first_lines.line: <28>Nov 24 15:44:24 dc1-core-mlag2 bridge,warning MLAG: remote heartbeat timeout

phases.name: Primary down
phases.expected: CHR 2 reverts its MLAG bonds to its own LACP system ID (mlag-lacp-fallback=yes), so the access switch and traffic host 2 renegotiate LACP, with brief loss. The virtual links keep carrier, so they drop the member to CHR 1 only at the LACP short timeout (3 × 1 s). The access switch's uplink is an edge port, so once LACP has reselected it forwards at once, without RSTP discarding and learning states.

phases.name: Primary back
phases.expected: CHR 1 keeps its bond members out of the bond until the MLAG system ID syncs (mlag-init-delay), rejoins as MLAG primary and restores the shared system ID. The access switch and traffic host 2 renegotiate LACP to the shared system ID with brief loss, and the access switch's edge uplink forwards again at once.
